capabilities: register a global hotkey with the operating system
show Obsidian from any app via the shortcut
hide Obsidian on a second press to return to the previous app
change or remove the hotkey through Obsidian's hotkey settings
extras: Desktop only; conflicts with other apps' shortcuts limit the hotkey to inside Obsidian, and multi-vault setups need per-vault shortcuts.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to summon or dismiss the app from anywhere in the operating system with one hotkey.
summary: Global-shortcut plugin that brings Obsidian to the front from any app and hides it again on a second press.
